g.text: J122 column-major: 1/4/7/10 = SIGNAL 1-4, 2/5/8/11 = RAW_ACT (+), 3/6/9/12 = GND. HV servos only, stall <= 3 A per pin.

g.desc: J122 column-major: 1/4/7/10 = SIGNAL 1-4, 2/5/8/11 = RAW_ACT (+), 3/6/9/12 = GND. HV servos only, stall <= 3 A per pin.

g.text: Order from the MCU: 10k pull-down and SRV05-4 clamp on the MCU side, then 1.0k 0805 series (P0-5), then the header.

g.desc: Order from the MCU: 10k pull-down and SRV05-4 clamp on the MCU side, then 1.0k 0805 series (P0-5), then the header.

g.text: PA0-PA3 = TIM5_CH1-4 (AF2). PUPDR = 00, OSPEEDR = 00, drive low at boot. TIM2 never gets a channel.

g.desc: PA0-PA3 = TIM5_CH1-4 (AF2). PUPDR = 00, OSPEEDR = 00, drive low at boot. TIM2 never gets a channel.

g.text: Quiet the servos (unloaded centre) before a pyro fire (P1-8). Two zip-tie holes straddle J122.
